theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

top_news.title: Xi Calls for Deeper Cooperation and Free Trade
top_news.summary: Xi Jinping says Asia-Pacific economies should expand trade and bilateral relations while recognizing their differences in history, culture and development. He speaks at the APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Xi Warns Against ‘Rampant’ Protectionism Ahead of Trump Talks
top_news.summary: Xi Jinping urged Asia-Pacific economies to deepen cooperation as he warned against rising unilateralism and protectionism, setting out a defense of free trade as China hosts global leaders for high-stakes talks on trade and technology.

top_news.title: China Sets Strongest Yuan Fixing Since 2022 as APEC Begins
top_news.summary: China’s central bank lifted its daily yuan reference rate to the strongest in over four years, a sign of tolerance for gradual gains as the nation hosts a key regional summit.

top_news.title: Gold Slumps Below $3,800 as Fed Officials Signal More Rate Hikes
top_news.summary: Gold dropped below $3,800 an ounce for the first time since September 2025 after Federal Reserve officials made the case for more interest-rate hikes to tackle stubborn inflation.

top_news.title: Japanese Restaurant Skylark Eyes More M&A After Ramen Chain Deal
top_news.summary: Skylark Holdings Co., one of Japan’s largest restaurant chains, plans more M&A in 2027, and expects its growth-investment budget to match at least this year’s ¥50 billion ($313 million), according to company management.

top_news.title: Stocks, Futures Pare Nvidia Earnings-Led Gains: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: A rebound in equities fueled by Nvidia Corp.’s better-than-expected sales forecast lost momentum as traders remained wary of the artificial intelligence trade following a punishing rout.

top_news.title: Cobalt’s Outlook Darkens as Memory Chip Costs Hit Gadgets Demand
top_news.summary: Chinese cobalt demand is weakening as soaring prices for memory chips hit sales of the electronic gadgets that use the battery metal.

top_news.title: Quant Trader Graviton Expands Office Space in India, Singapore
top_news.summary: Graviton Research Capital LLP has expanded into larger offices in India’s high-frequency trading hub of Gurugram and in Singapore as the homegrown firm gears up for an ambitious global expansion.

top_news.title: SQM Sees Positive Lithium Demand Outlook Even as Prices Slide
top_news.summary: Major lithium producer SQM continues to see “encouraging trends” in underlying demand as the industry confronts a renewed selloff in the battery metal and the prospect of rising supply next year.

top_news.title: Council on Foreign Relations’ McGuire on Trump-XI Meeting Implications for Chips
top_news.summary: Chris McGuire, Council on Foreign Relations' Senior Fellow on China and Emerging Technologies discusses US restrictions on Nvidia chip sales and remote access, as the US president prepares to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping at the APEC summit. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Ed Ludlow on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)
